quests.title: Welcome to Empyrean Engines
quests.subtitle: Read me first
description: The ground is yours to build on. The sky is not.
Everything valuable floats above &bY 250&r, where nobody can place or break blocks. To reach it you'll need to build something that flies.
Start like any vanilla world. This book is your guide: it opens new chapters as you find things and learn new ages.

quests.title: Server Rules
description: &c-&r No building or breaking at or above &bY 250&r.
&c-&r The Nether is &b1:1&r with the Overworld. It's a destination, not a shortcut.
&c-&r No elytra and no teleporting.
&c-&r Mob farms don't work. XP comes from exploring.
&c-&r XP is &eknowledge&r: you spend it to research new recipes.

quests.title: Getting Started
description: Punch a tree and make a crafting table.

quests.title: Stone Age
description: Stone tools and a furnace. Your tools are made of parts. You'll learn what that means soon.

quests.title: A Roof and a Bed
description: Get through your first night.

quests.title: Something to Eat
description: Find a steady food source before you go far.

quests.title: Iron
quests.subtitle: Opens: Gears & Metals
description: Your first iron ingot. Look closer at your tools.

quests.title: Andesite
quests.subtitle: The start of every machine
description: A grey stone with a future. Andesite plus iron makes andesite alloy, the backbone of Create. You'll need to research it first.

quests.title: The Price of Knowledge
quests.subtitle: Opens: March of Industry
description: Lapis is the key to research.

Every recipe beyond vanilla has to be researched at the &eResearch Bench&r. Research costs &eXP&r plus a few sample items, and it's per player. One person can learn machines and supply the rest of the team.
When you research an age, its chapter in this book opens.

quests.title: The Sky Is Off-Limits
description: Climb a mountain and look up. Sky villages, wrecks and loot drift above &bY 250&r.
You can't pillar up there. You'll have to fly.

quests.title: Look Closer at Your Pickaxe
description: Every tool and piece of armour here is built from &eparts&r: a head, a rod, sometimes a binding or grip.
Each part's material decides the stats. Hover a tool and hold Shift to see them.
Better materials come from exploring. You won't know which metal is best until you find it.

quests.title: Blueprints
description: Blueprints and templates shape the parts. Craft a blueprint for the part you want, then craft it with your material.

quests.title: Swapping Parts
description: A mod kit lets you swap parts on a tool without starting over.

quests.title: Repairs
description: Load a repair kit with materials and use it on worn gear.

quests.title: A Splash of Colour
description: Paint your gear any colour you like.

quests.title: Salvager
description: Break old gear back down into parts and materials.

quests.title: Field Notes: Metals
quests.subtitle: Hints for hidden entries
description: Each metal gets its own entry here once you hold it. Rumours so far:
&7-&r Something red runs in the walls of the Nether.
&7-&r Blue veins are said to glitter in the End.
&7-&r Black crystals hide deep below the stone.
&7-&r Some of the best metals aren't mined at all. They're alloyed in the foundry.
The &eFoundry&r (Alloy Age) casts parts and doubles your ore.

quests.title: Copper
description: A new material for your gear. Check its stats with Shift.

quests.title: Gold
description: A new material for your gear. Check its stats with Shift.

quests.title: Diamond
description: A new material for your gear. Check its stats with Shift.

quests.title: Bort
description: A new material for your gear. Check its stats with Shift.

quests.title: Crimson Iron
description: A new material for your gear. Check its stats with Shift.

quests.title: Blaze Gold
description: A new material for your gear. Check its stats with Shift.

quests.title: Crimson Steel
description: A new material for your gear. Check its stats with Shift.

quests.title: Netherite
description: A new material for your gear. Check its stats with Shift.

quests.title: Azure Silver
description: A new material for your gear. Check its stats with Shift.

quests.title: Azure Electrum
description: A new material for your gear. Check its stats with Shift.

quests.title: Tyrian Steel
description: A new material for your gear. Check its stats with Shift.

quests.title: Andesite Age
quests.subtitle: Learn this age at the Research Bench
description: This chapter guides you through the age once you've researched it.
&eResearch unlocks:&r andesite alloy, shafts and cogs, water wheels, the millstone, press, mixer, fans, drills, saws and belts.
&7Until then these recipes stay hidden in JEI and can't be crafted. You can still use and trade the items if someone else makes them.

quests.title: Andesite Alloy
description: The backbone of every early machine. Andesite plus iron nuggets.

quests.title: Shafts and Cogs
description: Rotation travels through shafts and cogs. Large cogs change speed.

quests.title: Water Wheel
description: Your first power source. Put it in flowing water.

quests.title: Stress
description: Every machine costs stress units (SU). Goggles show how much your network can handle.

quests.title: Windmill
description: More power, no river needed.

quests.title: Millstone
description: Grind ores, flowers and gravel.

quests.title: Mechanical Press
description: Presses ingots into sheets.

quests.title: Mixer and Basin
description: Mixing recipes. Some need heat underneath the basin.

quests.title: Belts
description: Move items between machines.

quests.title: Encased Fan
description: Blow through fire to smelt, through water to wash.

quests.title: Drills and Saws
description: Machines that break blocks for you.

quests.title: First Automated Farm
description: Build a farm that harvests and collects on its own.

quests.title: Alloy Age
quests.subtitle: Learn this age at the Research Bench
description: This chapter guides you through the age once you've researched it.
&eResearch unlocks:&r copper fluid handling, brass, and the foundry.
&7Until then these recipes stay hidden in JEI and can't be crafted. You can still use and trade the items if someone else makes them.

quests.title: Copper and Fluids
description: Pipes, pumps and tanks move liquids. Copper casing opens fluid machines.

quests.title: Spout and Drain
description: Fill and empty items with liquids.

quests.title: Foundry Bricks
description: A tier 1 foundry is built from plain bricks: floor, walls and corners, all the same kind.

quests.title: The Foundry
description: A multiblock that melts metal: a &eFoundry Controller&r in a brick wall, an air inside up to 7x7 and 8 tall over a floor made entirely of &eSolid Fuel Heaters&r, a brick ring around the heaters, walls of bricks and &eFoundry Drains&r, and a &eBrick Wall&r up every corner. Put items in through the controller. Hold &eW&r over the controller for a Ponder.
Raw and crushed ore melt into &emore&r than an ingot: x1.2 in brick.

Blow a running Create fan into an &eAir Intake&r in the ring around the heaters for more heat, slower heat loss, x1.4 ore and &ealloying&r (brass, netherite and Silent Gear's alloys only come from here).

Later, &eFire Bricks&r and &eLava Heaters&r: hotter, x1.6, slower heat loss, and the diamond-tier metals. Melt sand into &eMolten Glass&r here, then pour 250 mB over &eFire Clay&r on a casting table for a &eFire Brick&r; four make a block.

quests.title: Casting
description: A &eFoundry Tap&r on a drain pours into a casting table or basin below. Pour molten gold over an ingot, nugget, plate, gem or Silent Gear part to make a reusable &egold cast&r of it, or click sand onto it for a one-use sand cast.
Silent Gear parts from metals and gems above iron can only be cast here, not crafted by hand. Pour metal over finished gear to coat it.

quests.title: Brass
description: Copper and zinc, alloyed in the foundry (alloys only come from the foundry now). Brass opens the next age and the sky.

quests.title: Brass Age
quests.subtitle: Learn this age at the Research Bench
description: This chapter guides you through the age once you've researched it.
&eResearch unlocks:&r brass machines, mechanical crafters, deployers and arms, precision mechanisms, crushing wheels, steam engines and trains.
&7Until then these recipes stay hidden in JEI and can't be crafted. You can still use and trade the items if someone else makes them.

quests.title: Brass Casing
description: The shell for smarter machines.

quests.title: Electron Tubes
description: Polished rose quartz in an iron sheet.

quests.title: Mechanical Crafters
description: Big recipes, done by machines.

quests.title: Crushing Wheels
description: Automated ore processing. The foundry was the first upgrade. This is the next.

quests.title: Deployers
description: A hand that uses items for you.

quests.title: Mechanical Arm
description: Picks up and places items between machines.

quests.title: Precision Mechanism
description: Your first sequenced assembly line: deploy, press, repeat.

quests.title: Rotation Speed Controller
description: Set an exact RPM.

quests.title: Electricity Age
quests.subtitle: Learn this age at the Research Bench
description: This chapter guides you through the age once you've researched it.
&eResearch unlocks:&r Crafts & Additions: alternators, motors, the rolling mill and wires.
&7Until then these recipes stay hidden in JEI and can't be crafted. You can still use and trade the items if someone else makes them.

quests.title: Alternator
description: Electricity only comes from rotation. An alternator turns RPM into power.

quests.title: Rolling Mill
description: Rolls ingots into rods and wire.

quests.title: Wiring
description: Carry power between buildings.

quests.title: Electric Motor
description: Power back into rotation, wherever you need it.

quests.title: Accumulator
description: Store power for later.

quests.title: The Nether Is Calling
description: The next age needs blaze power. The Nether opens through a server-wide project.
See &eInto the Unknown: The Nether&r.

quests.title: Exotic Age
quests.subtitle: Learn this age at the Research Bench
description: This chapter guides you through the age once you've researched it.
&eResearch unlocks:&r the Melee Elemental research focus (Fire Aspect, and Smite's lightning) when you bind books at an enchanting table. Exotic material chains come in a later update.
&7Enchanting itself is open from the start: the quests below walk through it.

quests.title: Echo
description: Put a plain book and some lapis in an enchanting table. Click a button to begin: the three buttons light up and chime in an order. Click them back in the same order.
Three rounds, each one step longer. A wrong press costs 1 lapis and plays the round again. Books in chiseled bookshelves around the table play it slower.
Finish the third round and the book becomes a &dResearch Focus&r for a random kind of gear.

quests.title: First Research
description: Put the focus back in the table and open its research tree. Pick a level: it costs a few XP levels to start, then the table pulls its resource from a chest, barrel or vault up to 2 blocks away.
A book holds one enchantment. Researching a different line replaces it, so bind more books for more enchantments.
Feed it with a hopper or a Create belt and the bigger levels research themselves.

quests.title: Chosen Enchantment
description: Shelve the researched focus in a chiseled bookshelf two blocks from the table, with a clear block between.
Now put a tool, weapon or armour piece in the table: the buttons list what the shelved foci know. Pick exactly the enchantments you want. Books are never used up.

quests.title: A Wreck in the Hills
description: Something came down here. Someone was flying.
Search the wreck. There may be a map.

quests.title: Flight
quests.subtitle: Learn Flight at the Research Bench
description: Whoever flew that wreck knew something you don't. Research Flight to learn it.
&eResearch unlocks:&r Create Aeronautics: envelopes, burners, propellers, levitite, the physics assembler and controls. Needs the Brass Age first.

quests.title: Physics Assembler
description: Turns a build into a moving physics object.

quests.title: Hot Air
description: A burner under an envelope. The simplest way up.

quests.title: Propellers
description: Rotation into thrust.

quests.title: At the Helm
description: Steer and throttle from the deck.

quests.title: Levitite
description: A block that wants to float.

quests.title: First Flight
description: Take your ship above &bY 250&r and bring it back in one piece.

quests.title: Navigation Table
description: Plot a course.

quests.title: Sky Village
description: Villages float high above the build limit. Land, trade, and see what they sell.

quests.title: Highwind
description: A rarer, windier village.

quests.title: Drifting Cargo
description: Lost cargo, still floating.

quests.title: Pillager Airship
description: They fly too. Board it.

quests.title: The Nether Key
quests.subtitle: Unlock a nether portal
description: Nether portals won't light. Try one: the fire goes out, and a block of the frame turns into an &5Obsidian Keyhole&r.
Search &eruined portals&r: every one hides a &bFragmented Obsidian Key&r in its chest.
Research the fragment at the Research Table (Metallurgy). It shows you how to cast it whole again: the fragment on a casting table, with 4 ingots of molten gold poured over it.
Use the &dObsidian Key&r on the keyhole and the portal will light. Every new portal needs its own key.

quests.title: Through the Portal
description: The Nether is 1:1. Every block there is a block here.

quests.title: Blaze Rods
description: Blaze power for the Exotic Age.

quests.title: Capture a Blaze
description: Catch a blaze in an empty blaze burner. Superheated mixing needs it.

quests.title: Logistics
quests.subtitle: Learn this age at the Research Bench
description: This chapter guides you through the age once you've researched it.
&eResearch unlocks:&r item vaults, portable storage interfaces, packagers, frogports and stock tickers.
&7Until then these recipes stay hidden in JEI and can't be crafted. You can still use and trade the items if someone else makes them.

quests.title: Item Vault
description: Bulk storage that grows with size.

quests.title: Funnels
description: Pull items in and out of anything.

quests.title: Packages
description: Box up items and send them by frog.

quests.title: Stock Ticker
description: Order from your whole network at one counter.

quests.title: Ship Cargo
description: Load and unload moving contraptions and ships.

quests.title: Docking
description: Moor your ship at a dock.

quests.title: Trains
description: Rail lines for heavy freight. Trains are part of the Brass Age.

chapters.title: Night Raids & Gems
chapters.subtitle: Every fifth night they come for you

quests.title: The Night Raid
quests.subtitle: Read me
description: Every &c5th night&r raiders come for the Overworld: a &cNight Raid&r. You get a warning at dusk the evening before, and on the night &cbeds don't work&r.
From nightfall, waves of raiders spawn &e30-40 blocks&r from every player who is on the ground. They come for you, and if they can't reach you they &cbreak in&r: about 30 seconds per block.
They can only break plain Minecraft blocks. &aChests, furnaces, beds and every block from Create, Create: New Age, the foundry or any other mod are safe&r, and so is obsidian.
Players &bon an airship or flying&r get no waves. Players close together share one siege.
&7/silentraids status&r shows when the next one is.

quests.title: World Tiers
description: Your &6world tier&r rises on its own with your play time and milestones:
&aHaven&r at the start, &eFrontier&r at 5 h, &6Ascent&r at 15 h once you've been to the Nether, &cSummit&r at 30 h once you've killed the Wither, &5Pinnacle&r at 60 h once you've been to the End.

A higher tier means harder night raids (more waves, better armour on the raiders, Elites and then Invaders) and better gems. It also lets your gear reach higher levels. Sieges get a little harder within a tier too, the longer you play.

quests.title: Gear That Grows
description: &6Silent Gear&r tools, weapons and armour gain &eXP&r as you use them: tools by mining (ores give more), weapons by hitting monsters, armour by taking hits from mobs.
Every level gives &a+5% to all stats&r. Levels &b3, 6 and 9&r each add a &bgem socket&r.
The top level depends on your world tier: 3 in Haven, 5 Frontier, 7 Ascent, 9 Summit, 10 Pinnacle. XP keeps counting at the cap.
The Salvager won't take apart gear with levels or gems.

quests.title: Your First Gem
description: There's no enchanted 'affix' loot here: Apotheosis gives &dgems&r only.
Monsters drop them now and then. Raid &6Elites&r always drop one, and &5Invaders&r several.
Put a gem in a socket at the smithing table (gear in the middle, gem on the right). A &bSigil of Withdrawal&r takes gems back out.

quests.title: Sigil of Socketing
description: A Sigil of Socketing adds &bone extra socket&r to any piece of gear, at the smithing table. Each item can take only one.
Sigils can't be crafted. They come from quests, raid Elites and Invaders, and from beating every wave of a night raid.

quests.title: Gem Cutting
description: Grind spare gems into &dgem dust&r at the Salvaging Table, then use the Gem Cutting Table to raise a gem's purity.

quests.title: Summit
quests.subtitle: Kill the Wither
description: Killing the Wither is the milestone for &cSummit&r (with 30 hours of play).

quests.title: Pinnacle
quests.subtitle: Reach the End
description: Reaching the End is the milestone for &5Pinnacle&r (with 60 hours of play).
